integrity: Theorem and rational signs independently reconstructed analytically; reproducible standard-library checker; numeric cases are supplementary and are not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Idealized phenomenological saturated-growth and linear-buoyancy assumptions; Stokes sphere size scaling not general for fractal marine snow; illustrative coefficients uncalibrated; no prediction of real carbon export; historical-priority risk for mathematical extensions of broad settling equations.
title: A sharp drag–saturation threshold for reentrant marine-aggregate settling
